title: Eclipse Goddess in Ruins
description: A surreal scene depicts a pale female figure with glowing blue flame-like hair emerging from a broken stone sarcophagus entwined with thorny vines. Three black ravens with red dripping elements fly around a massive red and black solar eclipse in a dark, stormy sky above ancient ruined pillars and glowing green runic stones.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a pale female figure with bright blue flame hair rising from a broken stone sarcophagus wrapped in thorny vines and red branches, set among ancient ruined pillars overgrown with ivy, three black ravens with dripping red elements flying in a dark stormy sky dominated by a giant red solar eclipse with black center, glowing green runes on foreground stones, mystical and apocalyptic atmosphere, detailed digital painting
